title: Countries with Blue and White Flags

_: Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) light blue, white, and light blue, with a golden sun emblem in the flag's center.
Light blue field with a single white, five-pointed star in the center.

Three equal horizontal stripes of (from top) light blue, white, and light blue, with five blue five-pointed stars arranged in an X shape centered in the white stripe.
Nine horizontal stripes of alternating blue (5) and white (4) with a blue square cut into quadrants by a white cross in the upper left/hoist side.
A white field with a blue Star of David in the center, framed by thick blue horizontal stripes just below the top edge and above the bottom edge.

Three equal horizontal bars of (from top) blue, white, and blue, with the national coat of arms in the flag's center. Coat of arms features five volcanoes, a red Phrygian cap, and a rainbow all in a triangular frame flanked by blue-and-white flags and wreathed by laurel branch…
White field cut into fourths by two thick, dark blue stripes, one horizontal and one vertical and slightly left-of-center.
Nine horizontal stripes of alternating white (5) and blue (4) with a white square in the upper left/hoist side and a golden sun inside the square.
Pale blue field with four white five-pointed stars arranged in a diamond shape in the center.

Half-white (upper), half-light-blue (lower) field with coat of arms in center. Coat of arms features three towers, a crown, branches of oak and laurel, and a banner emblazoned with the word "Libertas".
